reviews.title: Good value stable even in a raid configuration.
reviews.comment: I have always have bought main stream drives but thought I would give these a try and save some money. I do a lot of software and hardware testing so I have a Dell server with multiple virtual machines on multiple hard drives. I set these up in Raid 1 and have had no issues. It's been months sense I set these up but so far so good.
reviews.author: S. H.

reviews.title: Fast, quite and compatible.
reviews.comment: I put these drives into a Synology NAS and had no compatibility issues. They are fast and quite. Big enough for daily backups.
reviews.author: Jim Barkdull

reviews.title: Bad lot??? Issue resolved in professional manner.
reviews.comment: Purchased these SSDs for my NAS.  5 months after installation, SSD started to fail one by one indicating bad cluster.  Tried toubleshooting with tech support, and found 4 out of 3 of them were flagged by NAS, but Win 11 didn't.  1 of them failed Win 11 check disk and Gigastone decided to do right thing.  After all, Gigastone tech & customer support was providing amazing support to resolve my issue in professional manner.
reviews.author: HIROYUKI Y.

reviews.title: DON'T BUY! Horrible customer service and support.
reviews.comment: DONT BUY!!! They sent me a drive that doesn't work and despite trying to get help from them their customer service is horrible. Replies days later with excuses asking for unrelated information. I am now stuck with several drives I cannot use. They know I cannot use them in a server and will do nothing to help me.
reviews.author: John D.

reviews.title: Budget SSD
reviews.comment: These SSD's are a great option for someone on a budget that wants to upgrade their older HDD spin drive to a more speedier SSD drive.
reviews.author: Michael D. Bragg
